dedupe_keys.name: building height in halle using number of levels

description: The FAIRiCUBE project provides a GeoTIFF of estimated building heights for Halle, Germany. Its own description says it multiplies OpenStreetMap building-level counts by an empirically chosen 3.0 metres per floor. The coefficient was selected by testing mean absolute and root mean square errors against available ground-truth heights. Zenodo offers the public raster under CC BY 4.0. Building-height estimates can inform urban energy-demand, solar-shading and wind-exposure simulations where surveyed heights are unavailable. The layer is one of three separately deposited Halle estimates with different input methods, so it should be compared, not combined as an independent measurement. Missing OSM level tags and variation in storey height remain likely limitations; the page does not publish a local uncertainty map. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Halle method output. The GeoTIFF was not downloaded, and its pixel resolution and error statistics were not independently checked.
